notes.title: Update 8th January
notes.notes:
Hi 

Today we have updated the game, the main features of the update are:-

1. On the formation screen it is now possible to rearrange the players by selecting the shirts.
2. Right clicking on a shirt on the formation screen will now display his profile.
3. Substitutes screen layout improved.
4. Match intro screen layout improved.
5. Fixed an issue where language panel background may be wrongly used when starting new game.
6. Edit mode, fixed issue with player position.
